# PiTTy 0.6.53

## Codex Fast speed and timing attribution

- Fixed missing speed, TTFT, and Turn/Tool timing for `openai-codex-fast` in Ctrl+P and settings model pickers. Fast-mode replies identify themselves as the underlying `openai-codex` provider; PiTTy now keeps measurements under the selected provider when the model IDs agree.
- Existing history is preserved, not copied into Fast mode: historical regular and Fast measurements cannot reliably be separated. New qualifying Fast responses populate the correct entry.

Verified with a real `openai-codex-fast/gpt-6.1-sol` request and rendered picker output at 104 and 180 columns. Typecheck passed; existing suite: 653 passed, 1 skipped.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.53` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
